name: afxdp-socket
why: socket(AF_XDP=0x2c) is the express-data-path capture surface; the family alone is the signal
source: synthetic: shape of normalize() output for afxdp_socket_behavioral.c's socket() record

name: afxdp-eperm-attempt
why: an AF_XDP open rejected with EPERM (no CAP_NET_RAW) still emits the socket() record; the attempt is the telemetry the atomic produces and the rule catches
source: synthetic: afxdp atomic run without CAP_NET_RAW (success=no, exit=-EPERM)

name: afpacket-wrong-family
why: an AF_PACKET (0x11) raw socket is the Strategy 1 surface, not AF_XDP; the a0 family constraint must be load-bearing

name: afinet-dgram-wrong-family
why: an ordinary AF_INET (0x2) UDP socket shares the socket() syscall but not the AF_XDP family; flipping only a0 fires it
source: synthetic: a normal UDP socket open

name: unrelated-syscall
why: an execve by an ordinary process: a sanity floor that proves the family selection does not fire on noise
